title: 第14章：暗中联络，密谋出逃
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

晚上九点，小楼里一片寂静。

王德发已经睡熟了，抱着他的宝贝箱子，嘴角挂着一丝满足的微笑，似乎在梦里已经当上了青山镇的二把手。

苏晴轻轻拍着女儿的背，妞妞靠在她怀里，睡得很香。

陈明和李小雨坐在角落，假装在低声聊天，手指却在不停地绞着衣角。

周建国把一套扳手在桌上摊开，擦了又擦，目光时不时瞟向窗外。

林昊坐在桌边，面前是一张工业园的简易地图，手指在上面画着一条条撤离路线。

“动手。”

他抬起头，说了两个字。

赵铁柱点头，起身，像一头准备捕猎的黑豹，悄无声息地推开后窗。

他没有用手，而是用肩膀顶开，避免发出任何锁扣的声响。

窗外是三米高的地面，他翻出去，双手扒住窗沿，身体下坠，在离地半米时松手，双脚落地，连一丝尘土都没扬起来。

几秒钟后，他消失在小镇错综复杂的阴影里。

林昊站起身，走向苏晴。

“五分钟后，带上妞妞和李小雨，从后门走，直接上车，锁死车门。”

他把一把手枪和两个弹匣塞进苏晴手里。

“会用吗？”

苏晴接过枪，熟练地拉开套筒检查了一下，又把弹匣推进去。

“在医院时，安保队长教过。”

林昊又看向周建国。

“你，现在去配电室。理由是检修线路，防止夜间短路。赵永年住所地下室的独立供电线路，你知道在哪儿。”

周建国的手停住了，他抬起头，眼里有恐惧，但更多的是一种豁出去的决绝。

“我知道。剪断那根线，他地下的监控和那扇密室的电子锁，就全瞎了。”

“聪明。”林昊拍了拍他的肩膀，“五分钟后动手，然后立刻到车上来。”

最后是陈明。

“你待在二楼，盯着镇长小楼的方向。周建国动手后，赵永年的人肯定会出来查看。你看清他们往哪个方向走，用对讲机告诉我。”

“明白。”陈明的手心里全是汗。

安排完一切，林昊独自走出小楼，朝着停在广场上的房车走去。

门口监视的老马打了个哈欠，看见他出来，随口问了一句。

“林兄弟，这么晚了去哪？”

“明天要去个远地方，路况不熟，我得检查一下车，加固一下底盘。工具都在车上。”

这个理由无懈可击。

老马点点头，没再多问，缩回板凳上继续打盹。

林昊拉开车门，坐进驾驶座。

手指在半空中划过，系统面板无声展开。

【车辆状态：100%】

【油料储备：100%】

【能源储备：100%】

【武器系统：已激活】

万事俱备，只欠东风！

黑暗里，赵铁柱的行动快如鬼魅。

他先是绕到机修工小刘的棚屋，学了三声猫叫。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At nine o'clock in the evening, the small building was silent.

Wang Defa was already fast asleep, holding his treasure box with a satisfied smile on his lips, as if he had become the second-in-command of Qingshan Town in his dream.

Su Qing patted her daughter's back gently, and Niu Niu leaned in her arms, sleeping soundly.

Chen Ming and Li Xiaoyu sat in the corner, pretending to chat in a low voice, but their fingers kept twisting the corners of their clothes.

Zhou Jianguo spread a set of wrenches on the table and wiped them again, glancing out the window from time to time.

Lin Hao sat at the table, with a simple map of the industrial park in front of him, and his fingers drew evacuation routes on it.

"Do it."

He raised his head and said two words.

Zhao Tiezhu nodded, stood up, and quietly opened the back window like a black panther preparing to hunt.

Instead of using his hands, he pushed it away with his shoulders to avoid making any locking sounds.

The ground outside the window was three meters high. He rolled out, grabbed the window edge with both hands, and dropped his body. He let go when he was half a meter above the ground, and his feet landed on the ground without raising even a trace of dust.

After a few seconds, he disappeared into the tangled shadows of the town.

Lin Hao stood up and walked towards Su Qing.

"In five minutes, take Niuniu and Li Xiaoyu with you, go through the back door, get in the car directly, and lock the door."

He put a pistol and two magazines into Su Qing's hand.

"Will it work?"

Su Qing took the gun, skillfully opened the slide, checked it, and pushed the magazine in.

"The security captain taught me when I was in the hospital."

Lin Hao looked at Zhou Jianguo again.

"You, go to the power distribution room now. The reason is to repair the lines to prevent short circuits at night. You know where the independent power supply line is in the basement of Zhao Yongnian's residence."

Zhou Jianguo's hand stopped, and he raised his head, with fear in his eyes, but more of a determination to risk everything.

"I know. If you cut that wire, his underground surveillance system and the electronic lock in the secret room will be completely blind."

"Smart." Lin Hao patted him on the shoulder, "Start in five minutes, and then get to the car immediately."

Finally, there is Chen Ming.

"You stay on the second floor and stare in the direction of the mayor's small building. After Zhou Jianguo takes action, Zhao Yongnian's people will definitely come out to check. If you see which direction they are going, tell me through the intercom."

"Understood." Chen Ming's palms were all sweaty.

After arranging everything, Lin Hao walked out of the small building alone and walked towards the RV parked in the square.

Lao Ma, who was watching at the door, yawned and asked casually when he saw him coming out.

"Brother Lin, where are you going so late?"

"I'm going to a distant place tomorrow and the road conditions are unfamiliar. I have to check the car and strengthen the chassis. All the tools are on the car."

This reason is impeccable.

Lao Ma nodded, didn't ask any more questions, and retreated to the bench to continue taking a nap.

Lin Hao opened the door and got into the driver's seat.

His fingers passed through the air, and the system panel unfolded silently.

[Vehicle status: 100%]

[Oil reserve: 100%]

[Energy Reserve: 100%]

[Weapon system: activated]

Everything is ready, all we need is the east wind!

In the darkness, Zhao Tiezhu moved as fast as a ghost.

He first went around to the mechanic Xiao Liu's shed and learned three cat meows.
